from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.lookdev import get_renderer_profiles
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Renderer_Profile(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_renderer_profile"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("renderer",      "string", widget_type="text", default="usd_preview_surface")
        self.add_input("material_name", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]
        self.add_output("profile_json",          "string")
        self.add_output("material_mapping_json", "string")
        self.add_output("renderer_supported",    "bool")

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        renderer      = str(inputs.get("renderer",      "usd_preview_surface") or "usd_preview_surface")
        material_name = str(inputs.get("material_name", "") or "")
        try:
            profiles = get_renderer_profiles()
            supported = profiles.validate_renderer_support(renderer)
            profile   = profiles.get_profile(renderer)
            mapping   = profiles.map_material(material_name, renderer) if material_name.strip() else {}
            self.log_info(f"Renderer profile: {renderer} → {profile.material_class} (supported={supported}).")
            return {
                "profile_json":          json.dumps(profile.to_dict(), sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "material_mapping_json": json.dumps(mapping, sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "renderer_supported":    supported,
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Renderer profile query failed: {exc}")
            return {"profile_json": "{}", "material_mapping_json": "{}", "renderer_supported": False, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Renderer_Profile
